subject: Operations
title: Service Operations Strategy
description: Learn Service Operations Strategy in one minute.

hook.text: A hospital, a bank, and a theme park are all service operations. Strategy differs when the product is an experience.

buildup.text: Service operations can't stockpile output—capacity must be available when the customer arrives.

discovery.text: Services balance capacity, customer contact level, and customization—different combinations create different strategies.

twist.text: High customer contact makes quality harder to control—every interaction is a live performance with no rehearsal.

climax.text: Disney theme parks engineer every touchpoint—from queue design to cast member scripts—turning service into precision.

punchline.text: In services, the customer is part of the process.

quiz.question: Why is service quality harder to control than manufacturing?
options: Every interaction is live with the customer present
